Description: ElastiCache Clusters found without automated snapshots, or without a retention of at least 7 days.
Risk: Automated backups are necessary for ease of operations, and a short retention period cannot guaranty the ability to ensure a safe recovery point, in case of corruption, accidental deletes, or other failures.

Recommendation.Text: Enable automated backups for elasticache, with a long enough retention period, preferably greater than 7 days.
